title: U.S., Israel Elections Loom Over Iran War
text:
On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg Economics Defense Lead Becca Wasser and Bloomberg News Middle East correspondent Dan Williams examine how elections in the U.S. and Israel could shape the next phase of the Iran war, including the possibility of renewed U.S. strikes after the midterms. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Wasser and Williams assess potential U.S. military options, Iran’s capacity to retaliate and the political calculations facing President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.Watch the full interview on Bloomberg.
